text: Om. From the hearing of the disrespect shown to Shuga, and from the fact that he was not addressed by name, it is indicated that he was a Shudra. Since the qualification for the ritual is that of a human being, and because of the lack of distinction, even a Shudra is qualified, as stated by Pautrayana: “He, having taken away the Shudra…” Therefore, he says: From the hearing of the disrespect shown to Shuga, and from the fact that he was not addressed by name, it is indicated that he was a Shudra. That Pautrayana was not a Shudra; the mere fact that he was not addressed by name indicates his Shudra status. This is indicated by the statement, “Let this be a Kambara (a term of contempt).” It is indicated by the statement, “He, indeed, addressed the Kshatriya with a slur.”
